# Lakshie Real Estate Advisory

> Real estate listings and advisory for residential plots, villas and other properties in Bengaluru and Dubai. Confirm listing details, availability, approvals, and charges with the advisor.

## Core Properties & Portfolios

- Puravankara describes Purva Symphony as an enclave at The Sound of Water, off Bannerghatta Road, Bengaluru, offering 3- and 4-BHK villas. Developer-listed project RERA: PRM/KA/RERA/1251/310/PR/210907/004300. See the [official project page](https://www.puravankara.com/residential/bengaluru/purva-symphony) for current project information; confirm inventory and pricing directly.
- [Seller-listed resale at Purva Symphony, The Sound of Water](https://premium-plots.vercel.app/purva-sounds-of-water): One seller advertises a five-bedroom unit and quotes ₹9.0 Cr, with reported land/built-up areas. These are unit-specific seller claims, not developer-verified facts; confirm configuration, area basis, features, price, legal documents and availability with the advisor.
- [Plots in Bangalore Directory](https://premium-plots.vercel.app/plots-in-bangalore): BIAAPA and RERA approved residential plots and villa plots up to 4,499 sq.ft across 6 prime Bengaluru corridors (Devanahalli Airport, Chikkaballapura Nandi belt, APC Circle, Jigani, Tumkur Rd, Kanakapura Rd) priced from ₹35 Lakhs to ₹2.0 Cr.
- [Luxury Villas in Bangalore](https://premium-plots.vercel.app/luxury-villas-bangalore): Curated villa listings including a seller-advertised resale at Purva Symphony, The Sound of Water, and Tripon Nandi Hills homes.
- [Oriaiyan Signature Plotted Developments](https://premium-plots.vercel.app/plots-in-bangalore): Flagship plotted enclaves across Devanahalli, STRR, Jigani, and Chikkaballapura.
- [Sun Valley Scenic Plots Chikkaballapura](https://premium-plots.vercel.app/plots-in-bangalore): Serene plotted community in Chikkaballapura with unobstructed Nandi Hills views, priced from ₹35 Lakhs to ₹90 Lakhs.
- [Tripon Nandi Hills Luxury Villas](https://premium-plots.vercel.app/luxury-villas-bangalore): Gated 15-acre enclave offering 3, 4, 5 BHK custom architectural villas in Nandi Foothills from ₹2.4 Cr to ₹4.0 Cr.
- [Tripon Aero Gardens Airport Residences](https://premium-plots.vercel.app/?page=apartments): High-rise luxury residences 5 minutes from Kempegowda International Airport Terminal 1 & 2, priced from ₹52 Lakhs to ₹1.5 Cr.
- [Vinra KBR Residences](https://premium-plots.vercel.app/?page=apartments): Twin-corridor urban residences at Chikkajala (Airport expressway) and Kothanur (Hoskote East belt) priced from ₹59 Lakhs to ₹1.9 Cr.
- [Dubai Global Waterfront Estates](https://premium-plots.vercel.app/?page=dubai): Tax-free 8-10% USD rental yields in Dubai Marina and Harbour with 10-Year UAE Golden Visa residency qualification under RBI LRS route.
